context.problem_statement: Given a time series dataset of monthly financial indicators with heteroskedasticity, forecast the next 3 months using an appropriate time series model. Identify and handle the heteroskedasticity in the data before forecasting. Compute the forecasted values for the next 3 months and provide the RMSE of the model on the training data.
context.expert_knowledge: Time Series Forecasting in finance often involves ARIMA models for capturing trends and seasonality. Heteroskedasticity is common in financial data, requiring models that can handle time-varying volatility, such as GARCH for volatility forecasting or using robust standard errors in ARIMA models.
